recipe.title: Plan recruiter coordination and handoff deadlines
recipe.scenario: A recruiting team has approved meetings but needs coverage for confirmations, room checks, and missing feedback reminders. Schedule internal work against agreed service targets. An overdue checkpoint prompts a human follow-up, never an automatic decision about an applicant.

field.name: checkpoint-ids
field.description: Unique task IDs for scheduling administration, not applicant records. Examples: interview confirmation check, panel replacement check, room setup check, and feedback form completion reminder.

field.name: request-links
field.description: One opaque approved interview request ID per checkpoint, in checkpoint order. Provide no applicant contact details, feedback text, assessment result, medical or accommodation details, or documents.

field.name: checkpoint-windows
field.description: For each checkpoint: earliest start and latest completion in UTC, plus the staff role responsible for the task. A due time is a service target set by the owning team, not a legal deadline asserted by this recipe.

field.name: task-minutes
field.description: One positive expected effort in minutes per checkpoint, in checkpoint order. Compare effort to staff working windows and keep each task within a single window.

field.name: dependencies
field.description: Directed pairs of checkpoint IDs: previous task, next task. The next task may start only after the previous task finishes. A feedback reminder cannot precede completion of the relevant interview.

field.name: completed-prerequisites
field.description: Opaque request ID, prerequisite code and actual UTC completion for checkpoints whose predecessor happened outside the plan, such as a completed interview. A missing completion does not count as satisfied.

field.name: staff-capacity
field.description: Each row contains an opaque staff ID, an approved coordinator role, available UTC windows, and net reserved minutes for recruiting operations. Respect both time-window and capacity limits and do not double-book people.

field.name: proposed-task-plan
field.description: One row per placed checkpoint: ID, proposed UTC start and end, and staff ID. Prefer completing more checkpoints by their agreed due times, then use earlier due times to break scheduling ties.

field.name: overdue-or-blocked
field.description: Each unscheduled task ID with a reason such as missing prerequisite, no qualified staff window, or insufficient capacity before the target. Return it to the recruiter for review without changing an applicant's status or messaging anyone.

field.name: planned-by-target
field.description: Count of scheduled checkpoints whose planned end is no later than their agreed target. This is a planned operational measure, not a record that any applicant step has completed.
